# Stefano D'Ambrosio — Portfolio

> Front-end developer based in Berlin. Builds fast, content-driven websites and web apps with Astro, React and TypeScript, from design to deployment.

## About

- Role: Front-end developer, currently at BRG
- Location: Berlin, Germany
- Education: Degree in Computer Science, University of Bologna
- Focus: Astro, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, headless CMS (Sanity), Supabase
- Also: graphic design, photography and videomaking
- CV: [CV_Stefano_DAmbrosio.pdf](https://www.stedamb.dev/data/CV_Stefano_DAmbrosio.pdf)

## Projects

- **Big Bench App**: map, passport and guestbook for the 450+ Big Benches across Italy and Europe. React, Vite, Supabase, Leaflet, Capacitor.
  - Live: [big-bench-app.vercel.app](https://big-bench-app.vercel.app)
  - Source: [github.com/Stedamb/big-bench-app](https://github.com/Stedamb/big-bench-app)
- **Portfolio**: this site, with a serverless contact form. Astro, React, Tailwind CSS, Resend.
  - Live: [stedamb.dev](https://www.stedamb.dev)
  - Source: [github.com/Stedamb/portfolio](https://github.com/Stedamb/portfolio)
- **AnimaNoire**: website for a tattoo studio in Rimini, with content managed in a CMS. Astro, Sanity.
  - Live: [anima-noire.vercel.app](https://anima-noire.vercel.app)
  - Source: [github.com/Stedamb/animanoire](https://github.com/Stedamb/animanoire)
- **Videomaker Portfolio**: video-focused portfolio and travel journal. Astro, React islands, View Transitions.
  - Live: [videomaker-psi.vercel.app](https://videomaker-psi.vercel.app)
  - Source: [github.com/Stedamb/videomaker-portfolio](https://github.com/Stedamb/videomaker-portfolio)
- **Minimal Portfolio**: photography portfolio with Payload CMS, live preview and a WebGL ASCII hero. Astro, Payload, Next.js, Postgres.
  - CMS admin: [minimal-portfolio-cms.vercel.app/admin](https://minimal-portfolio-cms.vercel.app/admin)
  - Live: [brut-folio.vercel.app](https://brut-folio.vercel.app)
  - Source: [github.com/Stedamb/minimal-portfolio](https://github.com/Stedamb/minimal-portfolio)
- **Journal**: personal journal of short essays, written in Markdown. Astro, Tailwind CSS.
  - Live: [personal-journal-chi.vercel.app](https://personal-journal-chi.vercel.app)
  - Source: [github.com/Stedamb/journal](https://github.com/Stedamb/journal)

## Client work

- **LuxCoin**: showcase of an ancient coin collection. Next.js, Sanity. [luxcoin.it](https://www.luxcoin.it)
- **Da Lenin Barber Shop**: website for a local barber shop. Astro. [daleninbarbershop.it](https://www.daleninbarbershop.it)

## Tech stack

TypeScript, Astro, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Supabase, Sanity, Node.js, Figma
